title: All-hands March 2026 - announcement + Q&A (scratchpad)
body:
TL;DR:
- Quick FYI draft for the March 2026 all-hands announcement and prep notes for CEO town. Still a scratchpad - pull quotes and numbers need sign-off from finance/cto.

Context:
- Theme: 'Serving for scale' - highlight Dedicated GA improvements, Private pilot wins, and progress on runtime latency SLOs.
- Audience: company-wide (~150 ppl). Emphasize ops wins and what it means for product teams.

Key messages (proposed):
1) Progress on reliability & latency: p99 median latency down ~18% for our top 5 hosted models after kernel selection improvements and new batching logic. CTA: mention SRE/serving-runtime team.
2) Dedicated & Private momentum: 3 pilot customers onboarded to Private (regulated finance & health), Dedicated contracts renewed with two customers.
3) Product roadmap: Console rollout for rollout policies + cost breakdowns in beta for customers.
4) People & scale: Hiring update (SRE + infra), shoutouts to recent promotions.

Suggested opening script (CEO):
- One-liner: "As model builders and platform operators, our job is to make LLMs predictable and practical at scale."
- Quick wins: cite latency and Dedicated renewals.
- Thank ops and product teams, call out top 3 cross-functional contributors.

Talking points for engineering leads:
- Serving-runtime (Samira): what we shipped (kernel selection, KV cache improvements), measured impact numbers (need finance-approved figures).
- Private (Lucas): three pilots, what we learned about onboarding, next steps for scale.
- Console (Omar): rollout APIs and tracing improvements for customers - demo snippet idea: per-route latency waterfall.

Anticipated questions + draft answers (Q&A):
Q: "Are we seeing a material change in unit costs after batching/quantization work?"
A: Early results show per-token cost down ~12% on selected workloads due to smarter batching and cache hits; still broader benchmark in progress. Point to Redwood Optimize pilot and upcoming report (link to Confluence).

Q: "Will Dedicated customers see different SLAs?"
A: Yes - Dedicated contracts include higher uptime guarantees and predictable throughput; outline differences (short bullets) and where to escalate (sales-eng).

Q: "How is Private different from self-hosted open-source runtimes?"
A: Emphasize control plane, onboarding support, KMS/HSM integrations, and audit logs + our managed rollout tooling - not just a binary runtime.

Q: "Hiring & org changes?"
A: Briefly mention open roles and that hiring is focused on infra & SRE. No org-shape announcements beyond hiring.

Open items / TODOs before final publish:
- Get final latency/cost numbers from analytics by EOD Tue (ASSIGNED: samira ali).
- Legal review of customer mentions (PRIVATE pilot names) (ASSIGNED: rachel chen).
- PR for slides deck (marketing) - link to be added once merged.
- One-line shoutouts list from managers (due Fri).

Logistics:
- Draft slides: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketing/pull/56 (waiting on visuals)
- Run-of-show: CEO 8 min + 3 x 4 min leads + 10 min Q&A (use Slido?), live captions on.

Notes to self / scratch ideas:
- Consider small customer quote from pilot (anonymized) to put in slide 2.
- Demo idea: live trace that shows rollback/automatic fallback when Dedicated pool is saturated (stretch objective).
- Keep the phrase "production-first developer experience" in at least one slide.

Slack posts (draft):
- Short announcement post for #all-hands pre-reminder 48 hours out.
- Follow-up TL;DR post and link to recording + FAQ doc.

References / links to include in final doc:
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/COMM/All+Hands+Mar+2026
- Internal evals: CON-ML-299 (embedding regressions for v2 quantization)
- Jira tickets: JIRA-OPS-842 (kernel selection perf), JIRA-DED-214 (Dedicated renewals)

Questions for leadership / items to confirm:
- Do we want to call out customer names for Private pilots or anonymize? (Legal to confirm)
- Which exec will do the hiring update? (People Ops recommendation: CFO/Head of People?)
- Final approval deadline: Thu EOD to publish next Mon.

This is a living scratchpad - will tidy and convert into slides + speaker notes after numbers/PRs are final.
